name: Ian Diaz-Rainey

story: The 2022 NZGRC paper listed a form 'Ian Diaz-Rainey', while the University of Otago's STRAND project identifies Ivan Diaz-Rainey for the related research. This is retained as a name-variant reference with the contribution attached to the canonical Ivan record.
